rows.got:
**⭐ THREE FINDINGS ON ONE OPENING.**

**1. A Defranceschi, and the index was right.** «**36 vetus · 14 novus** · 12 8bris 1806 · **Catharina filia defti Josephi De=franceschi, CÆLEBS ex Loco** · **56** ann. · **Asthma**». *[A new person](/person/catharina-defranceschi-d1806/) — unmarried, born about 1750, daughter of a Josephus already dead. The second* «cælebs» *Defranceschi woman in this book after [Sancta](/person/sancta-defranceschi-d1792/). Birth year* **not** *declared.*

**2. ⭐ The register NAMES the two house-numbering systems** — «vetus» *and* «novus» — *which [this archive had only inferred](/worklist/). Three labelled pairs:* **36→14, 8→52, 107→76.** **⚠ They scatter**: «8 vetus» → «52 novus» *is six times larger, not half, so this is a* **permutation, not a scaling**, *and the earlier* «about half» *reading is now unsettled. Flagged on the worklist; nothing withdrawn.*

**3. The parish priest dies in office, and four parishes bury his people.** «ad. R.ndus **FELIX ANT. BOBICH, Parochus Loci**» *— house 1, 11 December 1805,* **aged 43**, **Appoplexia**. *The officiant column then runs through outsiders:* «**P[res]b[yte]r Cher=bunensis**» *(**KRBUNE** — [worklist 168](/worklist/)),* «Capellanus **novacensis**», «Gasparus Suran, **Par: Cerovglensis**», «Joannes Ant. … **Coop. Petinas**» *(Pićan), until* «**Ant: Ferdinandus Mocovich, Parochus Loci**» *takes the book in September 1806.* ***A fifth Krbune sighting, and the first one with a reason attached: an interregnum.***

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 31–36 walked (M01069244–M01069246), 1807–1812
rows.what: Continuing the walk through the French-period years, to the edge of the 1812 confiscation already recorded here.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ No Defranceschi death in these six pages — a named nil.** *What they give is the parish around the family.*

· **⭐ «gratis».** *p. 35, 1811: the priest writes it under his own name on three consecutive burials — houses 83, 34, 93.* **The burial was free.** *Set beside [the flyleaf's bell-ringing payments](/gologorica-line/) and the 1803* «Fames» *and* «Egestas» *deaths, the book records* ***who paid for bells, who paid nothing, and who starved.*** *No Defranceschi in any of the three.*

· **⭐ «Joannes Baptista DEPRATO, Viduus»**, *house* **6**, *30 March 1809, aged 56 — the widower of [Catharina Deprato](/gologorica-line/), who died at house* **61** *in 1803.* **⚠ 61 old → 6 new is an INFERENCE** *(the 1803 entry predates the vetus/novus labelling), consistent with the 1826 census putting Deprato at house 6.* ***Not counted as a labelled pair.***

· **A sixth Krbune priest, and the arrangement named**: «Ant: Trinaistich … **Cherbunensis**, **de Licentia mea** Parochus» *(1809). With [the 1805 interregnum](/gologorica-line/), the two parishes clearly lent clergy as standing practice. [Worklist 168.](/worklist/)*

· **A stranger**: «**Gertrudis Zwey, Vidua, ex Hyperlabaco**» — *Oberlaibach (Vrhnika), dead at house 1 in 1809, aged 46.*

· **A trade**: «Joannes Ghersan, viduus, **faber ferrarius**» — *blacksmith, 67.*

· **Four decanal visitations** *in eleven years — 1805, 1807, 1808, 1816 — two signed* «**Petrus Anicich**, Cæs. Reg.us Parochus et Decanus».

· *A girl* «**ab obstetrice baptizata** ob necessitatem» *(1808), and a* «**filius posthumus**» *(1812) whose father is on the same page, dead of phthisis five months earlier.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, page 41 (M01069249), 1814–1815 — a famine emigration, recorded with its certificate
rows.what: Walking on into the years after the French confiscation already recorded here.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ THE PARISH RECORDS AN EMIGRATION, ITS REASON, AND THE PROOF.**

> *27 April 1815, house 80:* «**Joannes Ancich q.m Judicis Joannis filius ex Rismagnizza** · annor. **40** · **FAMES**»
> «obiit in Istria ex Veneto, quo ***egestatis causa cum familia sua se contulerat***»
> «Matthæus Loganis, **Parochus Foscolini in Istria ex Veneta**, sepelivit ibi in Ecclesia S.ti Rochi, *uti ex ejusdem Parochi Attestato patet*»

***He left for Venetian Istria with his family because of destitution, and starved there at forty.*** *The home parish entered it on a certificate from the parish that buried him —* **a documented out-migration with a stated cause**, *which is not a thing this archive has had before.* *And he was the son of the* **Judex**, *the village judge.*

**Two more on the same page:** *a stranger* «ex Parochia Paasbergensi», *c.40,* «**inventus mortuus in via**» *(found dead on the road, 12 Feb); and* «Matthæus Flegar … **Inopia consumptus**» *(consumed by want), 54, 6 March, at eight at night.*

**⚠ Not identified here:** *where* «Foscolino in Istria ex Veneta» *is today. Not guessed at.* **⚠ Not explained:** *why 1815 was a hunger year — Tambora erupted that April and this man was dead by the 27th.*

**⚠ No Defranceschi on this page.** *The second hunger crisis in twelve years after [1803](/gologorica-line/), and the family is absent from it as from the bell payments and the* «gratis» *burials.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 42–44 (M01069249–M01069250), 1815–1816 — the famine counted
rows.what: Walking on from the 1815 emigration entry to find how far the hunger ran.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ THIS EXTENDS A FINDING PUBLISHED EARLIER THE SAME DAY, AND THE EARLIER NUMBER WAS TOO SMALL.** *[The first write-up](/gologorica-line/) said* «three deaths from want in eleven weeks», *which was true of page 41 and nowhere near the whole.*

**Walking pages 42–44 brings the tally to SEVEN hunger deaths across THIRTEEN MONTHS**, *March 1815 to April 1816:* «Inopia consumptus» *(54)·* «**Fames**» *(40, in Venetian Istria)·* «**Fames**» *(46)·* «**Fames** et paralysis» *(52)·* «**Tabes famelica**» *(45)·* «**Fames**» *(**4 years old**)·* «Tussis et **Fames**» *(58).* **With [the five of 1803](/gologorica-line/) that is twelve in this one book.**

**⚠ And not only the poor**: *the Venetian-Istria death was the son of the* «**Judex**»; *a woman on page 44 is wife of the* «**Suppanus**» *— the župan.*

**The Ancich of houses 79–81 lose four in 1815**, *one of them buried next morning* «ob signa putrefactionis».

**⚠ Still no Defranceschi.** *Pages 41–44 are a named nil for the surname.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 45–51 walked (M01069251–M01069254), 1816–1817 — the famine counted off the page
rows.what: Walking the famine years entry by entry to establish how many died and who.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ PAGE 51 CARRIES SEVEN BURIALS AND ONE CAUSE: «Fames».** *26 April – 8 May 1817.*

**The count, from reading every entry: at least 34 hunger-attributed deaths** — *5 in 1803, 4 in 1815, 3 in 1816, and* ***22 in the first five months of 1817 alone***. *Seven different constructions:* «Fames», «Egestas», «Inopia consumptus», «Tabes famelica», «Cancrhrena famesque», «Extenuatio», «Debilitates fame mendicando». **⚠ The walk stopped at page 51 with deaths still running, so 34 is a FLOOR.**

**Nine children** *— aged 3, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 7, 9, 11, 14, 18 — and five households lost two or three:* **h81 Rabar: three daughters** *(4, 3, 7)·* **h73 Udovicich: two brothers five days apart** *(6, 7)·* **h105 Rade: father and daughter** *(39, 3)·* **h46 Zabran Schina: three**, *one* «inventus mortuus ruri» *and buried only* «post sectionem a chirurgo factam»· **h75 Udovicich Giacotich: father and daughter.**

**⚠ Not only the poor**: *the* «**Suppanus**» *Thomas Flegar died of* «Extenuatio» *in Feb 1817; his predecessor died the same month; [the Venetian-Istria death was the* «Judex» *'s son](/gologorica-line/).*

**What people did**: *begged (*«fame mendicando»*), left (two deaths abroad entered on receiving priests' certificates — Venetian Istria 1815, Paasberg 1817), and died where they fell (*«in via», «sub dio in abysso», «ruri»*).*

**⚠ CAUSE NOT CLAIMED.** *The 1817 peak fits the post-Tambora famine; the* **1815 phase cannot** *— Joannes Ancich was dead on 27 April 1815, eleven days after the eruption. Two phases; the famous explanation fits one.*

**⭐ Also found: «Catharina, Vid. defti LEONARDI DEPRATO», h.6, 25 March 1817, ann. 77,** «inventa mortua» *— the head-name of the index block* «Deprato Leonardus N.º 6», *confirming house 6 as the Deprato house for a third time.*

**⚠ NO DEFRANCESCHI** *in any of it. Across pages 1–51 the family appears five times and never among the hunger dead, the bell-payers, or the* «gratis» *burials.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 52–54 walked (M01069254–M01069255), May–July 1817
rows.what: Walking on to test the figure published an hour earlier. It was too low.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ THIS RAISES A FIGURE PUBLISHED EARLIER TODAY, which is the point of walking rather than sampling.**

*[The section written after page 51](/gologorica-line/) said* «at least 34 … a floor, not a total». **Pages 52–54 added eighteen more hunger deaths, bringing the running total to at least 52 — about 40 of them in 1817 alone.** ***And the walk stopped at page 54 with the register still carrying roughly a dozen a month, so 52 is still a floor.*** *The number was raised, not defended.*

**Two more whole-household tallies emerged:** *house* **81** *(Rabar) lost a* **fourth** *— the father Georgius, 40,* «Fames et hydropisis», *after his three daughters; house* **46** *(Zabran Schina) lost a* **fourth**, *Joannes, 16; house* **105** *(Rade) a* **third**, *Joannes, 8; house* **75** *a* **third**, *the mother, 55,* «hydropisis famelica».

**Two more one-year-olds** *died of* «Fames» *in June 1817. A woman was* «**inventa … in Valle agonisans**» *— found in the valley, dying. One of the dead came* «ex territorio **Cherbunensi**» *— [Krbune again](/worklist/) — and one died at* **Pazin**, *buried by its chaplain.*

**⚠ Still no Defranceschi**, *pages 52–54.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 55–57 and 63 (M01069256–M01069257, M01069260), Aug 1817 – 1823
rows.what: Re-reading pages a previous session had opened for ONE person, and walking them properly to find how the famine ended.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ THESE PAGES HAD BEEN OPENED BEFORE — for Clementina, not walked.** *Reading every entry is what turned up the rest.*

**⭐ THE SHAPE OF THE WHOLE CRISIS:** «Fames» *Jan–Jul 1817 →* «**Fluxus**»/«Dissenteria seu Fluxus sanguinis violentus» *Aug–Sep →* «Febris maligna»/«Phtysis» *Oct–Dec.* ***Starvation, then the epidemic that takes the starved, then the long tail.*** *By page 63 (1821–23) mortality is ordinary again and the form has changed to record the dead person's* «conditio» *and the priest's signature.*

**One more hunger death, and a lesson in record-keeping**: *a sixteen-year-old,* «Mathias Braticich … **Fames**», *died* **2 July 1817** *at San Pietro in Selve but is entered among the* **September** *burials, with the priest's explanation —* «Hic inscriptus, quia mense 7bri demum mors ejusdem scripto tenus ab eodem Parocho annunciata fuit». ***The fourth parishioner to die away from home in this crisis.***

· *A girl of ten entered* «**muta et surda**» *— the only disability named in the walk.*
· *Same-day burials ordered* «ob signa putrefactionis, **et nimium foetorem**».

**⚠ CONSERVATION NOTE FOR THE NEXT PERSON:** *a DAPA label is filmed with page 56 —* «**WATER DAMAGE · OŠTEĆENO OD VLAGE**». *The volume is damp-damaged at this point.*

**⚠ No Defranceschi, pages 55–57 or 63.**

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 65–66 (M01069261), 1826 — a Defranceschi buried at Barban, and the index decoded
rows.what: The last unread page the death book's index points at for a Defranceschi.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ FIRST, WHAT IS NOT NEW.** *[This archive already held Maria's death](/person/maria-rosalia-defranceschi-1789/) — 30 September 1826, aged 37y 2m 10d — from the* **1826 household census**, *and had already used that age to fix her birth at 20 July 1789 and to marry up three roster rows with* `sameAs`. ***Finding her in the death register is a verification.***

**⭐ WHAT IS NEW is the entry's own content:** «Die 30: 7bris 1826 hora **3tia** p.m. · **12** · Maria filia Defti Jo:is B:tæ Defranceschi · 37 · **hectica** · Adm.dm Rev. D.nus **Lorentius Batel, Ca[pell]anus ad S. Petrum in Barbana, ibi sepelivit**». ***The house, the cause, the hour — and that she was buried at BARBAN***, *forty kilometres south, by its chaplain, not in her own parish.* **⚠ Why she was there is not known and is not guessed at.**

**⭐ AND IT DECODES THE INDEX.** *Tested five ways, the* «N.º» *on each index block is the household's* **house number**: «Deprato Leonardus **N.º 6**» ✔✔✔ *(three Deprato deaths at house 6)·* «Joseph **N.º 17**» ✔ *(Amalia, 1826)·* «Joanes Bapta detti Lonardi **N.º 12**» ✔ *(this entry).* **The two misses are both pre-renumbering**, *so the number is the* ***new*** *house, assigned once when the index was made.*

***Three Defranceschi addresses, in the numbering every later register uses: Joseph 17, Joannes Baptista «detti Lonardi» 12, Leonardus 10.***

**⚠ Hypothesis, not a pair:** *if Leonardus is house 10 new, and his father Antonius died at house* **29** *in 1802 (old), then* **29 vetus = 10 novus**. *Not written anywhere; [flagged on worklist 171](/worklist/) for the remaining pages to confirm or kill.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 57–58 and 65 (M01069257, M01069261), 1817–1826 — a re-read that caught a stale row
rows.what: Walking the last pages the index flags, and testing each finding against the roster rather than assuming it had landed.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ THE ENTRY ON PAGE 58 WAS ALREADY FOUND EARLIER TODAY. Saying so is the point.**

«Die **19: Xbris 1817** hora 10ma noctu · **17** · **Maximilianus Joseph Defranceschi, D.ni Josephi filius** · **4** anni, mens. fere **3** · Vermes et Tussis cum febri maligna» *— buried the 20th* «sub solis occasum ob signa putrefactionis». *[The line data already carried this death.](/gologorica-line/)*

**⭐ BUT THE ROSTER ROW DID NOT — and that is a real catch.** *[His row](/person/maximilianus-josephus-de-franceschi-1813/) still read* «Tree-derived: **no register has been read for this person here**» *with* `d: null`. ***A finding written into one file and not the other.*** *[Exactly the failure the propagation check exists for](/method/), and it survived because nobody tested the roster against the page. Now fixed and re-declared.*

**⭐ And it confirms the index decoding a fourth time**: *the child dies at* **house 17**, *which is the number the index gives his father's block —* «Defranceschi **Joseph N.º 17**». *His father is styled* «**Dominus**».

**⚠ Birth not declared**: *four years three months in December 1817 implies about September 1813; an implied year is not a declared one.*

**⚠ Page 65 (1826): no Defranceschi** *— read because an earlier log line claimed* «pages 65–66 walked» *when only page 66 had been opened. The claim is now true.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 69–71 (M01069263–M01069264), 1829–1831 — a SECOND numbering system
rows.what: Walking past the end of the book's index, into years no index covers.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ FROM 1830 THE HOUSE IS WRITTEN AS A FRACTION:** **65/32 · 103/61 · 41/17 · 111/68 · 31/12** *— upper between* **1.6 and 2.6×** *the lower.*

***That is the «about half» pattern [worklist 171](/worklist/) was built on — and it is NOT the 1806 pairing the priest labelled*** «vetus»/«novus», *which scatters (36→14, 8→52, **8→52 more than sextuples**).* **So the worklist has been asking about two different systems as if they were one, which is why the table would not come out.** *The item is now split.*

**Settled:** *a renumbering about 1806, in the priest's own words, three labelled pairs.*
**Not settled, not guessed:** *what the 1830s fraction is. A near-constant ratio is the signature of something other than a permutation — a conscription number, a cadastral parcel, paired houses.*

**⚠ A coincidence to test, not a bridge:** *one fraction is* **31/12** *— this archive's* «casa 31» *and the index's* «detti Leonardi N.º 12». *But that 1831 entry is a* **Crismanich**, *and a Defranceschi died at house 12 in 1826.*

**⚠ No Defranceschi, pages 69–71.** *Note the book's index stops at page 67 (Dec 1826), so from here the walk has no index to lean on.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 72–73 (M01069264–M01069265), 1831–1833 — nineteen number-pairs collected
rows.what: Running the test set an hour earlier: collect the fractions and see whether the lower series is capped.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ THE DECISIVE BIT: 72/36 and 112/69 appear in the death register AND in [the baptism register's table](/worklist/). The two books use the same pairing**, *so their evidence pools — which it could not while they were separate puzzles.*

**Nineteen pairs:** 9/4 · 31/12 · 38/19 · 41/17 · 42/21 · 54/27 · 55/25 · 57/36 · 61/29 · 64/31 · 65/32 · 72/36 · 80/43 · 85/44 · 92/50 · 94/52 · 103/61 · 111/68 · 112/69

**upper 9–112 · lower 4–69 · ratio 1.58–2.58 near 2 · NOT order-preserving** *(41/17 crosses 38/19, 55/25 crosses 54/27).*

***Two series of different sizes is not a renumbering*** *— a renumbering moves the labels and keeps the count. So this is not the 1806 change the priest labelled* «vetus»/«novus».

**⚠ What the lower series is: NOT established and not guessed.** *⚠ 57/36 and 103/61 are uncertain page-scale readings, flagged not dropped.*

**⚠ No Defranceschi, pages 72–73.** *«Febris scarlatina» appears in 1832.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 74–75 (M01069265–M01069266), 1834–1838 — Josephus, and a second stale row
rows.what: Walking on through the Italian interlude into Petrus Milcetich's compressed format.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ THE DEFRANCESCHI ON PAGE 75 WAS ALREADY DOCUMENTED. Saying so, again.**

> «**Xbris 12°** · **Josephus Defranceschi** · **74** · 9 · 7 · **febris nervosa**» *— 12 December 1838.*

*[The line data already held this death](/gologorica-line/), and had already flagged that the age does not close: 74y 9m 7d before 12 Dec 1838 lands on* **5 March 1764**, *against a written birth of* **4 March 1765**. *This walk confirms both independently.*

**⭐ BUT THE ROSTER ROW WAS STALE — the second in one afternoon.** *It carried* **b. 1763** *and an* **empty note**, *while the line data had the documented 1765 and the whole story. Fixed and re-declared.* *[The first was Maximilianus.](/person/maximilianus-josephus-de-franceschi-1813/) [A method note is now recorded](/method/): a finding written into a topic file must be put on the person's row in the same breath, because* ***a missing sentence matches no grep*** *and the propagation check cannot see it.*

**Also on these pages:** *the* **Italian interlude** *— «Il di 3 Marzo», «Vecchiaja», «Tisica», «agricoltore» under Administrator* **Marco Marusich**, *1834–35, reverting to Latin under* **Petrus Milcetich** *— [consistent with the correction already published](/corrections/). Visitations now signed* «**Vidi. Petinae**» *— at Pićan. And from 1836 Milcetich switches to a* **compressed one-line format**, *which is why these pages carry twenty entries where earlier ones carried six.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 76–80 walked (M01069266–M01069268), 1839–1844
rows.what: Continuing the walk through Petrus Milcetich's compressed format.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ A NAMED NIL — about sixty entries, no Defranceschi.**

*From 1836 Petrus Milcetich writes* **one line per death** *instead of a ruled block, so these five pages carry roughly as many entries as the previous twenty.*

**What is on them anyway:**

· *A* **dysentery outbreak**, *October–December 1839.*
· **Three deaths recorded as** «**infortunium**» *— accident: a man of 26 whose house is given as* «ignoratur» *(unknown), a child of 4, a boy of 13, a man of 50.*
· «**Effusio sanguinis tempore partus**» *— haemorrhage in childbirth, a woman of 26, 1844.*
· **⭐ An entry struck out and rewritten**: *Georgius Zabran, 34, phthisis, cancelled under 1840 with heavy scribbles and entered again under* **5 January 1841** *— a scribal correction visible on the page.*
· *Repeated notes on whether the last rites were given —* «non refecta SS Sacramentis **ob repentinam mortem**», *and once* «munitus SS Sacramentis, **excepto Eucharistiae causa vomitus**».
· *Visitations now signed* «**Vidi. Petinae**» *— at Pićan —* **F. Coverlizza, Decanus**, *annually 1840–45. A monk,* «P. Placidus Adamichs, **Professus**», *buries one.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 81–82 walked (M01069269 AND M01069270 — a duplicate pair), 1845–1846
rows.what: Walking on, and finding the second duplicate exposure of the reel.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.pages: M01069269 and M01069270 are BOTH pages 81–82. Every entry read on both.
rows.got:
**⭐ A SECOND DUPLICATE PAIR — and for the second time the FIRST exposure is the defective one.**

**M01069269** *is cropped at the left edge and* ***the month column is lost***: page 82's seven deaths read* «22, 4, 26, 8, 28, 12, 26» *with no month attached to any of them.* **M01069270** *is the same opening framed wider —* «Martii 22, Augusti 4, 8bris 26, 9bris 8, 9bris 28, Decembris 12, Decembris 26». ***A year of dates that exist only on the duplicate.***

*With [pages 27–28, where a loose slip hid seven entries on the first exposure](/gologorica-line/), that is* **two for two**. ***Rule adopted: open the frame either side before accepting a page as read.*** *[Two automated attempts to detect duplicates had already failed](/method/), so this is manual and stays manual.*

**⚠ And the coverage figure overstates**, *because it counts frames cited and a duplicate pair is one opening counted twice.*

**⚠ No Defranceschi, pages 81–82.** *Two notable entries all the same: a girl of 15* «non munita sacramentis, **quia continue delirabat**», *and another of 15* «non munita … **quia ab initio morbi RENUEBAT muniri iisdem**» — ***she refused them***. *And house 45 buries* **Josephus and Mathaeus Ancich on the same day**, *both aged in days — almost certainly twins.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 83–84 (M01069271), 1847–1848 — Leonardus «civis», and two foundlings
rows.what: Walking on into 1848.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ VERIFICATION, NOT DISCOVERY** — *[the archive already held this death to the day](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-1766/).* **But the roster row carried the two years and nothing else — no note, no citation. The third bare or stale row found in one afternoon.**

> «**1848 Aprilis 14°** · **5** · **Leonardus Defranceschi, CIVIS**, refectus SS Sacramentis moribundorum et sepultus die 15° hujus · **82** · febris cum senectute»

**⭐ «CIVIS» where every other adult on the page is «agricola».** *Eighty-two in April 1848 closes exactly on the held birth of 30 January 1766.*

**⭐ AND THE TWO BOOKS TOGETHER:** *[a boy was baptised* **Leonardus** *at* **house 5** *on 22 January 1847](/person/leonardus-defranceschi-1847/), and* **this** *Leonardus died at* **house 5** *on 14 April 1848.* ***The child was named for a LIVING man, not a dead one*** *— fifteen months of overlap in the same house. The boy lived to 1917.*

**⭐ A category this archive had not met in these registers: «EX EXPOSITIS».** *Two foundlings in 1848 —* «Emilia Emerling, ex expositis», *1 year, house 46; and a nine-month-old at house 23.* ***Children boarded out from a city foundling hospital to village families.*** **⚠ Neither surname is local**, *which is the mark of it. Recorded as a category to watch, not a finding about any line.*

*Also: Milcetich records three times on page 83 that he was* **not summoned** — «quia vocatus non fuerit Parochus».

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 85–88 walked (M01069272–M01069273), 1848–1850 — two Defranceschi, and the register argues back
rows.what: Walking on into 1850, where the direct line's own people start appearing.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ ANTONIA'S DEATH IS NO LONGER THE TREE'S.** *[Her row said the death year came* «from the family tree» *and named* «the burial register, barely opened» *as where it would be settled.](/person/antonia-defranceschi-1849/)*

> «**1850 Januarii 21°** · **53** · **Antonia Defranceschi**, agla, sepul. die 23° huj · **dier. 28** · debilitas physica»

**⚠ The house does not match her baptism** *(house* **5***), and the number was tested before being believed: the whole house column of the page reads* **53 · 47 · 59 · 13 · 54 · 30 · 65 · 17 · 33 · 7** — ***two digits among two-digit neighbours***. *[Worklist raised.](/worklist/)*

**⭐ AND «CIVIS» A SECOND TIME.**

> «**Decembris 8°** · **7** · **Jacobus Defranceschi, CIVIS**, munitus ss. moribundorum et sepultus die 10 hujus · **88** · febris et senectus»

*House 7, [the house the 1826 census gives him](/gologorica-line/). With [Leonardus in 1848](/gologorica-line/) that is twice in eight pages —* ***the word is how this parish files this family***, *not an accident of one entry.*

**⚠⚠ AND THE REGISTER CONTRADICTS THIS ARCHIVE TWICE, which is worth more than agreement would have been.**

| | held here | the register |
|---|---|---|
| day | 3 Dec 1850 | **8 Dec 1850** |
| age | b. 21 Jul 1761 → **89** | **88** |

*Burial on the 10th fits the 8th, not the 3rd. And the age falls on* **1762** — *the year [the tree gave and this archive declined](/person/jacobus-de-franceschi-1761/).*

**⚠ NOTHING CHANGED.** *A precise birth beats an age* **if it came off a baptism**, *and nobody wrote down where 21 July 1761 came from — [@I33@ carries one line and no source](/gologorica-line/). [Two worklist items raised](/worklist/); the 1646–1806 baptism book on this same reel would settle it.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 89–94 walked (M01069274–M01069276), 1850–1854
rows.what: Continuing the walk past the family's own entries, into the 1850s.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ No Defranceschi in these six pages — a named nil.** *What they give is a* **category** *this archive had not met.*

**⭐ «EX EXPOSITIS» — FIVE FOUNDLINGS IN SIX YEARS**, *entered where the dead person's* **condition** *goes, beside* «agricola» *and* «civis»:

*Emilia* **Emerling** *(1, 1848, h.46) · a boy of 9 months (1848, h.23) · Josepha* **Schniker** *(1, 1851, h.61) · Theodora* **Frauttmann** *(2, 1851, h.45) · Pasqualis-Blasius* **Gasparich** *(3, 1853, h.73).*

***Children boarded out from a city foundling hospital to village families paid to keep them.*** **⭐ And the surnames split**: *Emerling, Schniker and Frauttmann are* **German, not Istrian** *— the names they arrived with. But* **Gasparich is a local name all over this register**, ***so that child carried the fostering family's surname.***

**⚠ WHICH IS A HAZARD FOR THIS STUDY.** *If a foundling could be entered under the surname of the house that took him in, then* ***a «Defranceschi» in these books is not necessarily one by blood***. *None of the five is. The mechanism is now documented here rather than discovered late.*

**⭐ «VARIOLAE SPURIAE»** *(1853, a man of 62) — false smallpox, the term for a modified attack in someone* **already vaccinated or previously infected**. *Against* «Pustulla» *(1789) and* «Variola» *(1811), that is an arc. ⚠ Not proof of a vaccination programme — one priest's word — but the distinction only exists if someone was drawing it.*

**⚠ One cause is ILLEGIBLE and stays so.** *Page 91, a boy of two months: the priest wrote a cause,* **struck it out and wrote another over it**. *The two inks will not separate at any magnification here.* ***A first glance suggested a specific and serious reading; the page would not support it, and it is recorded as unreadable rather than guessed.***

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 95–98 (M01069277–M01069278), 1855–1858 — a Defranceschi dying in the Deprato house
rows.what: Walking on through the 1850s.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
ev: Mathaea, with her own document at last
rows.got:
**⭐ ONE PAGE CARRIES A DEPRATO AND A DEFRANCESCHI FOUR MONTHS APART, IN ONE HAND — and the second dies in the first family's house.**

> **14 May 1858**, h.**3**: «**Ane Maria DEPRATO**, agla · 66 · febris»
> **8 Sept 1858**, h.**6**: «**Mathaea DEFRANCESCHI**, agla, munita s. sacramentis moribundorum, sepulta vero 9° hujus · **86** · hydropisis»

*Stacked one above the other the two surnames are plainly different words — [which is the only way this archive reads a «De—» name here](/method/).* **Eighty-six lands on 1772, the birth already held (20 February 1772), and her death — carried as «about 1858» — is now exact.**

**⭐⭐ AND HOUSE 6 IS THE DEPRATO HOUSE**, *by four marks: [the index block «Deprato Leonardus N.º 6»](/gologorica-line/) and the deaths there of [Joseph Deprato (1801)](/gologorica-line/), [Joannes Baptista Deprato (1809)](/gologorica-line/) and [Catharina, widow of the late Leonardus Deprato (1817)](/gologorica-line/).*

**⚠ AND THIS ARCHIVE ALREADY HELD THE LINE THAT CLOSES IT**, *without noticing:* «**Wife of Leonardus (house 6). Maiden surname not captured.**»

***So the economical reading is that Mathaea was born a Defranceschi and married a Leonardus DEPRATO*** *— these books enter married women under their birth surname as a matter of course.* **If so, the two «De—» families this archive has spent weeks separating are joined by marriage, and the separation has been of surnames rather than of people.**

**⚠ INFERENCE, NOT DOCUMENT.** *Nothing names her husband's surname. [Worklist 184 raised](/worklist/): the marriage register on this same reel, then the 1826 census page for house 6.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 99–102 walked (M01069279–M01069280), 1859–1862 — the parish priest's own entry
rows.what: Walking on to 1862, the year the baptism register shows a hand stopping mid-folio.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ THE ENTRY THIS ARCHIVE HAD SAID WAS NOT AVAILABLE.**

*[The section on the 1862 handover](/gologorica-line/) reads the* **baptism** *book and says it shows a man dying* «not in an entry — ***the deaths are not kept here***». *Walking the death register to page 102 found them:*

> «**22 Martii** · **M. R. D. Petrus Milcetich, Parochus loci** … sacramentis munitus, **sepultus est 24. huj.** · **58** · **pleuropneumonia**»

***Fifty-eight, pleuropneumonia, 22 March 1862, buried the 24th.*** *The hand that stops mid-folio in the baptism book stops because of this.*

**⚠ And the signature is the find within the find**: «**Franciscus Coverlizza, Parochus, Decanus Petinae**» — *[the Dean of Pićan who had signed the annual visitation at the foot of these pages since the 1840s](/gologorica-line/).* **The man who inspected Milcetich's book for twenty years wrote the line that closed it.** *The rest of 1862 is signed* «Blasius Zwölberr, Administrator Parochialis», *with two others taking one entry each —* ***the same borrowed-clergy pattern as [the 1805 interregnum](/gologorica-line/)***.

**1862 was a bad year twice over**: *a* **dysentery** *outbreak took five in August–September, and* «**variola** et hernia» *a man of 70 in July.*

**⚠ No Defranceschi, pages 99–102.** *A trade worth noting on page 101:* «Joannes Matcovich, **artifex pilleorum**» *— a hatmaker. And two more of Milcetich's capacity notes —* «quia **mente lapsa**» *and* «ob violentam febrim, **quae mentem ejus perturbavit**».

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 103–104 (M01069281), 1862–1863 — Lambertina née Peschle, and a claim withdrawn
rows.what: Walking on — and finding the entry that disproved something published two hours earlier.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ «1863 Julii 16 · 7 · Lambertina Defranceschi, CIVIS, sep. 17 Jul., munita omnibus s. Sacramentis · 77 · senectus».**

*[Her death was already held to the day](/person/lambertina-defranceschi-peschle-1786/) — this adds the* **house (7)**, *the* **status** *(«civis», the third in this family), the burial, and the sacraments. The register's* **77** *is the priest rounding the* **76 years 10 months** *computed from her birth of 17 September 1786.*

**⚠⚠ AND IT DISPROVED A CLAIM THIS ARCHIVE PUBLISHED TWO HOURS EARLIER.** *[The argument that a Defranceschi had married a Deprato](/gologorica-line/) rested on* «these registers enter a married woman under her **birth** surname». ***Lambertina was born PESCHLE and is entered «Defranceschi» — her husband's name.*** *And the premise's own star witness agrees:* «Catharina **DEPRATO** nata Rovisi … uxor Joh: Baptista» — *Deprato is the husband's family. It had been cited for the opposite.* **[Withdrawn on /corrections/](/corrections/); [a method note added](/method/): a sentence about how a register NAMES people is a claim about every page of it, and needs three outside-verified instances before it is published.**

**⚠ Also corrected:** *I first read her age as* **79** *at page scale; zoomed, it is* **77**. *Two cells read as one number.*

*Page 103 also shows the Aetas column splitting into* **years / months / days** *from 1862 — so every death from here gives a birth date to the day. And an entry* «Julius Antonius Klobotschnig, orf[anus]» *continues [the foundling traffic](/gologorica-line/).*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 105–110 walked (M01069282–M01069284), 1863–1866
rows.what: Walking the 1860s.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
ev: Victor, with his cause of death
rows.got:
**⭐ ONE DEFRANCESCHI, AGED FOUR.** «1866 Septemb. 11 · **7** · **Victor Josephus Defranceschi, cives**, sep. die 12. Sep. · **4 ann** · **Typhus**».

*[The birth and the day were already held](/person/victor-josephus-defranceschi-1862/) — born 22 April 1862 at house 7, son of* «Franciscus Xav. Defranceschi, possessor» *and* «Clotildis Ortis». ***The cause is new.*** **Third typhus in this book in four years** *(a man of 27 in 1863, a boy of 15 in Jan 1865, this child). ⚠ A presence, not an epidemic.* *And* «cives» *for the* **fourth** *time.*

**⚠ THE HARDEST ENTRY IN THE BOOK.** *p. 105, 6 Sept 1864, house 46:* «**— Rabar**, agricola **illegit.**» · «**mortuus natus**, **sepultus a mulieribus**». ***A dash where the forename goes*** *(unbaptised, so unnamed), and, where every other entry carries the priest's signature,* «**buried by the women**». *The only entry in 110 pages whose officiant column names nobody.*

**Six more orphans and foundlings in three years** — «Hugo … ex expositis», «Gherghetta orfanus», «Vatzat orfanus», «Dorgan orfana», «Princzic orfanus», «Maizan orfanus» — *surnames no more Istrian than Emerling or Frauttmann. [The category is now well attested here.](/gologorica-line/)*

**Two apparatus changes:** *from 1862 the* **Aetas** *column splits into* **years / months / days**, *so every later death gives a birth date to the day; and from January 1866* «**Jac. Bariha[s], Decanus**» *signs the inspection where Franciscus Coverlizza had since the 1840s.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 111–114 walked (M01069285–M01069286), 1867–1870 — a thirty-year correction
rows.what: Walking 1867–70 — and finding the entry a roster note had asked for three weeks earlier.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ A DEATH YEAR MOVED THIRTY YEARS, BY EXACTLY THE SOURCE THE ROW HAD ASKED FOR.**

> «**1870 Martii 10ma** · **7** · **Clementina Defranceschi, POSSIDENS**, munita SS Sacram. et sepulta 11. Martii · **47** · **Phthisis**»

*[The row carried a note of* **20 September***](/person/clementina-maria-defranceschi-1822/): tree* **1870**, *archive* **1840**, *and* «***this needs the burial register, not a judgement***». **It was walked today. Forty-seven on 10 March 1870 closes exactly on her declared birth of 3 October 1822; at 1840 she would have been seventeen.** ***The tree was right.*** *Death 1840 → 1870, [re-declared](/method/), [published on corrections](/corrections/).*

**⭐ AND THE REST OF THE PAGE IS AN EPIDEMIC.** *House* **28** *buries* **five in fourteen days** *— 3 to 17 January 1870, all* «**angina polyposa**» *(diphtheria): Josephus Flegar 37, Matthaeus 6, Joanna 10, Joannes 4, Catharina 1.* *Three more follow in March at other houses. [In 1868 the same register had twice given the cause as bare* «**Epidemia**»](/gologorica-line/).

**The status word shifts**: «**possidens**» *here, where the book said* «civis» *in 1848, 1850, 1863 and 1866. ⚠ Whether that is standing or vocabulary is not established.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 115–120 walked (M01069287–M01069289), 1870–1872
rows.what: Walking on through the 1870s.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ No Defranceschi in these six pages — a named nil.**

**⭐ BUT AN INFERENCE BECAME A FACT.** *[This archive had written that the* «ex expositis» *children were* «boarded out from a city hospital» *and flagged that as the obvious reading, not a documented one.](/gologorica-line/)*

> *p. 119, 4 January 1872, house 36:* «**Anna Cima d'or EX EXPOSITIS TERGESTI**, et sepulta die 5. h.»

***«Tergesti» — of TRIESTE.*** *Twenty-four years after the first such entry, the priest names the city.* **And the surname is itself diagnostic**: «Cima d'or» *is nobody's family name —* ***foundling houses invented surnames for children who had none***, *which explains the whole odd set (Emerling, Schniker, Frauttmann, Vatzat, Dorgan, Princzic, Maizan, Danel, Dubaz, Zerer, Angius).*

**⚠ The hazard sharpens rather than resolves:** *a surname in this book may be the child's, the foster-house's, or a clerk's invention.*

**The diphtheria vocabulary modernises too**: «angina **polyposa**» *in [the 1870 outbreak](/gologorica-line/) becomes* «angina **difterica**» *in October 1871.* *Also: scarlet fever, pleuroperipneumonia, phleborrhagia, volvulus — the causes are turning clinical.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 121–124 walked (M01069290–M01069291), 1873–1874 — Virginia, and two households
rows.what: Walking 1873–74.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ A TREE-ONLY CHILD GETS A REGISTER.** «1874 Septemb. 12 · **6** · **Virginia Defranceschi, agla**, sepulta die 14. h. · **1 anni** · **Hydropisia**». *[Her row had two years, no place and an empty note.](/person/virginia-defranceschi-1873/) Now a parish, a house, a cause and a burial.*

**⭐ AND THE HOUSE CLOSES AN OPEN QUESTION.** *House* **6** *is where [Mathaea Defranceschi died in 1858](/person/matthea-defranceschi-1772/), and it was the* **Deprato** *house in 1801, 1809 and 1817. A second Defranceschi dying there sixteen years later makes* ***«the house changed hands»*** *much the strongest reading — as [casa 31 did, to a Crismanich by 1831](/gologorica-line/).*

**⚠ AND A DISTINCTION TO HOLD:** *house* **7** *Defranceschi are* «civis» *(1848, 1850, 1863, 1866) and* «possidens» *(1870); house* **6** *Defranceschi are* «agla» *— agricola (1858, 1874).* ***Burghers at one address, farmers at the other, consistently across twenty-six years.*** **⚠ A difference in the clerk's word is not a difference in blood**, *and whether they are one family is not established.*

*Three more Trieste foundlings in 1873 — Marsch, Follo, Bellunovic.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 125–128 walked (M01069292–M01069293), 1875–1876 — a bishop, and a child baptised in the hand
rows.what: The last stretch of the walk.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐ A BISHOP SIGNS THE BOOK.** «**Vidi in visitatione CANONICA die 7. Julii 1876. G. Dobrila, Ep[iscopu]s**». *Every other inspection in 128 pages is signed* «**Decanus**». **⚠ The name points hard at [Juraj Dobrila](/worklist/), the Istrian national-revival bishop — but his see in 1876 and Gologorica's diocese need checking against each other. [Logged as an identification to verify, not asserted.](/worklist/)**

**⭐ AND A NEW PERSON, four words long.** «1876 Septembris 24 · **14** · **Maria De=franceschi, MERCATOR**, die 25. Septembris sepulta est» · cause «**Nata mortua**» · above it «**in manu baptizata**». ***Born dead, baptised in the hand.*** *[Minted and declared.](/person/maria-defranceschi-d1876/)*

**⚠ And it explains [the 1864 stillbirth](/gologorica-line/) by contrast**: *that child has a* **dash** *for a name and is* «sepulta a mulieribus» *— buried by the women. ***This one was baptised, so she has a forename, a parish burial and the priest's signature.*** The difference is the sacrament, not the family.*

**⭐ «MERCATOR» MAKES THREE STANDINGS**: «civis»/«possidens» *at house* **7**, «agricola» *at house* **6**, «mercator» *at house* **14**.

**⚠ A lead, not a conclusion:** *[the one labelled renumbering pair this archive has is* «36 vetus · 14 novus»](/gologorica-line/), *and casa* **36** *is an eighteenth-century Defranceschi house. If it became 14, this child died at the family's old address — but 84 years is long and houses change hands.*

*Also on these pages: «**Cancer**» and «**Hisseria**» appear for the first time; diphtheria recurs as «Difteritis»; and four more Trieste foundlings.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, pages 129–132 walked (M01069294–M01069295), 1877–1879 — a second decade corrected
rows.what: The end of the walk — and the second death year moved by decades in one day.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⭐⭐ «1878 Decembris 22. · 7 · Josephus Defranceschi, POSSIDENS, munitus SS. et sepultus die 24. Dec. 1878 · 70 · Senectus».**

*This archive had him dead on* **22 December 1857**. *Seventy on 22 December* **1878** *closes on his birth of 13 March 1808; at 1857 he would have been* **49**. *[The row had carried a note saying the tree said 1878, the archive 1857, and that the burial register was what the question needed.](/person/josephus-lambertus-defranceschi-1808/)* ***It was walked. The tree was right.***

**⚠ AND IT IS THE SECOND TODAY — which names the fault.** *[Clementina was moved from* **10 March 1840** *to* **10 March 1870** *this morning](/corrections/).* ***In both, the day and the month were already right and only the decade was wrong.*** **A confusion of two people scatters all three fields; this is a keying error** — *and [a method note now says so](/method/).* *Exactly three rows carry that note; two are closed, and [the third is on the worklist](/worklist/).*

**⚠ Also on these pages, and it explains an earlier entry:** «Maria Gasparić … **In pede baptizata — mortua edita**» *(1878) — ***baptised on the foot***. *With [«in manu baptizata» of 1876](/gologorica-line/), these are emergency baptisms of* **whichever limb presented** *in an obstructed birth.*

*And a three-year-old Trieste foundling, Carla Barabić, dead of* «**Crematio**» *— burning — in December 1877.*

rows.src: ⭐ DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS 1784–1880: THE BOOK WALKED END TO END (M01069226–M01069297)
rows.what: The completion of the walk: cover, flyleaf and pages 1–135, every entry of every page.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.pages: M01069226 (front cover) and M01069227 (flyleaf) through M01069297 (p. 135, the last written page). M01069298 onward is blank; the «D» blocks of the index at M01069301 were read, the rest of the alphabet was not.
ev: The whole walk, written into the line
rows.got:
**⭐ FINISHED. Ninety-six years, read entry by entry rather than searched for a surname.**

*The last line, 23 January 1880, is followed by a direction in* **Italian** *where the book is Latin:* «**Segue libro nuovo · Vol. IV**». ***So this is Volume III, and [Volume IV is now a named, dated target](/worklist/).***

**What the family got out of it:** *about* **twenty-five Defranceschi** *across the book;* **four people who existed only on the tree now have register entries** *(Antonius 1802, Maximilianus 1817, Antonia 1850, Virginia 1874);* **two newly minted** *(Catharina «cælebs» 1806, the stillborn Maria 1876);* **and [two published death years corrected by decades](/corrections/)** *(Clementina 1840→1870, Josephus 1857→1878 — both with the day and month already right).*

**⭐ The book buries three of its own parish priests, each entered by somebody else**: *Bobich (1805, 43, apoplexy), Milcetich (1862, 58, pleuropneumonia), Zwölber (1879, 57, asthma,* «morte improvisa»*).*

**And the parish around the family**: *[a famine of at least 52](/gologorica-line/), [a bell ledger and «gratis» burials](/gologorica-line/), [twelve Trieste foundlings](/gologorica-line/), [diphtheria taking five from one house in a fortnight](/gologorica-line/), smallpox under three names in eighty years, and [a bishop's signature where every other inspection is a dean's](/worklist/).*

**⚠ NOT DONE:** *the index beyond its «D» blocks; everything after January 1880 (Vol. IV, not on these reels); and of* **1,461 frames** *on the two reels,* **239 are cited** *— [Cerovlje and Gračišće are barely opened](/searched/).*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS, the INDEX walked for the married-in surnames (M01069299–M01069305)
rows.what: Reading the book's own household index through the alphabet, for the twelve surnames that married into this family.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.got:
**⚠ A NAMED NIL, and the naming is the whole value.**

*[The index is a* **household** *directory](/gologorica-line/): surname, byname, house number, members, page each died on. ***So its gaps are evidence.***

**Four of [the twelve married-in surnames](/married-in/) have no block in it:**

| | what the index HAS under that letter |
|---|---|
| **GRACH** | Gasparich · Gaspetich · Gherbaz · Ghersan ×2 · Giurando · Giuratich · Gregorovich |
| **JABLICH** | *the* «I» *column is* **blank** — *the index runs* **G → I (empty) → L**, *no H, J or K at all* |
| **PESCHLE** | Padovan · Palmano · Pascoli ×3 · Pavetich ×4 · Peer · Percich · Petrovich |
| **ORLIS/ORTIS** | Oppassich *alone* |

***All four women married in; none of their families kept a house here.*** **[Worklist 168 is redirected to Krbune accordingly.](/worklist/)**

**⚠ The claim is narrow, and deliberately so**: *a married woman is filed under her* **husband's** *surname, so a Grach or Jablich wife is in this book under his name; a servant, visitor or [foundling](/gologorica-line/) may head no block; and [the index stops about 1826](/gologorica-line/).*

**Positives picked up on the way:** «**Gherbaz, faber ferrarius, N. 22**» *(the blacksmith's house)·* «**Bobich N. 54** · R.dus Felix Ant. **Parochus** · 29» *(the 1805 parish priest, under his own family)·* «**Palmano N. 28**» *(the [PALMAN/SALAMON test family](/gologorica-line/), with an address)·* «**Pavetich Simon, obiit 20 Jan 1783**» *(a death a year* **before** *the book begins)· and house* **28** *held in turn by Palmano, [the Peer of 1805](/gologorica-line/) and [the Flegar of 1870](/gologorica-line/) — three families, one address, eighty years.*

rows.src: DAPA ZM34K-214 — Gologorica DEATHS index, letters R and after (M01069306) — a house-number map of the village
rows.what: Continuing the index walk and tabulating every household against its house number.
rows.film: ZM34K-214 (DAPA; held by the family as page images)
rows.pages: Index frames M01069299–M01069306. Not the whole alphabet: S–Z remain.
rows.got:
**⭐ FORTY-EIGHT HOUSEHOLDS MAPPED TO HOUSE NUMBERS** *— the first such map this archive has had, taken from the index's own block headings* («Surname alias Byname **N.<n>**»).

**⚠⚠ AND IT CATCHES A TRAP.** «**Rabar alias Tomelincich · N. 31**». *[This archive calls a Defranceschi household* «**casa 31**»](/gologorica-line/) *from the* **1780s baptism register — old numbering**. *The index is* **new** *numbering.* ***So casa 31 and N. 31 are different buildings.*** *[The archive had warned itself about exactly this](/worklist/); here is the warning coming true.*

**⭐ The positive counterpart**: *the one labelled pair* «36 vetus · 14 novus» *carries old casa* **36** *(a Defranceschi house in 1786, 1789, 1792) to* **house 14** *— and [a Defranceschi was buried from house 14 in 1876](/person/maria-defranceschi-d1876/).* **⚠ Suggestive, not proven.**

**⚠ Three numbers carry two blocks each (9, 84, 98)** — *successive occupants or page-scale misreadings, flagged not resolved.* **⚠ And S–Z of the index is not yet read.**

**⭐⭐ THE INDEX GIVES AT LEAST SIX HOUSE NUMBERS TWO HOUSEHOLDS EACH.**

| house | blocks |
|---|---|
| **6** | «**Deprato** Leonardus» · «**Sestan** Vincent» |
| **9** | Berdar · Peer |
| **48** | Oppassich · Runco |
| **55** | Runco Taraban · Sestan Sidre |
| **84** | Ancich Mattelicich · Rabar Baron |
| **98** | Ghersan · Pavetich |

***So a house number is an ADDRESS, not a household key.***

**⭐ WHICH CLOSES [WORKLIST 184](/worklist/), raised this morning.** *It asked why [a Defranceschi died at house 6 in 1858](/person/matthea-defranceschi-1772/) and [1874](/person/virginia-defranceschi-1873/) when house 6 was* **Deprato** *in 1801, 1809 and 1817 — and [a wrong answer was published and withdrawn over it](/corrections/).* ***The index answers it with no family connection at all: house 6 carries a SESTAN block too.*** **Deprato, Sestan and Defranceschi at one address across seventy years.** *[The question dissolves.](/method/)*

**Cross-references resolved**: «Benula» *=* «**Rovis** alias Benula N. 34»; «Smockvich» *=* Pascoli; «Socol» *=* Lucovich; «Padovan», «Cossin» *=* Muca; «Giuratich» *=* Crosgniach *and* Zabran. ***A family here can be found under three names, and the index is the only thing that joins them.***

**⚠ U–Z of the index is still unread.**
